title: Valve announces changes to Steam's review process, as a surge in game submissions pushes review times to "up to 12 business days", instead of the usual 3-5 days (Jay Peters/The Verge)
title_en: Valve announces changes to Steam's review process, as a surge in game submissions pushes review times to "up to 12 business days", instead of the usual 3-5 days (Jay Peters/The Verge)
author: The Verge
content_snippet:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Valve admits that it’s now taking ‘up to 12 business days’ to review games.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

In a new post today, Valve acknowledged that it’s seen “a significant increase in submissions for store and page review in recent months” and says it’s “running a little behind” by taking “up to 12 business days” for reviews instead of the typica
summary_en: Valve announced that due to a surge in game submissions, their review turnaround has extended from 3-5 to 12 business days. To clear the backlog, they are now mandating that developers verify their builds by running them through the Steam client for at least five minutes to minimize avoidable re-reviews.
title_zh: Steam游戏审核大排队
summary_zh: 由于开发者提交数量暴增，Steam审核周期延长至12个工作日，官方正通过强制测试要求来优化流程

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Valve近日公开表示，因游戏提交数量激增导致人工审核压力过大，平台审核周期已从常规的3-5个工作日拉长至最多12个工作日。为缓解积压，Valve修订了发布清单，要求开发者在提交前必须通过Steam客户端运行游戏至少5分钟，以过滤因基础功能缺失导致的无效重复审核。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Valve announced that due to a surge in game submissions, their review turnaround has extended from 3-5 to 12 business days. To clear the backlog, they are now mandating that developers verify their builds by running them through the Steam client for at least five minutes to minimize avoidable re-reviews.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Valve公司在Steam平台发布与审核后台：审核周期延至12天，并强制开发者进行Steam客户端预运行测试
【起因与机理】游戏提交流量过大且存在大量因低级错误导致的重复审核
【关键数据与实测】强制实施5分钟客户端运行测试。
【各方立场与态度】意在减少因基础错误引发的二次审核。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Valve (Steam store submission backend): Extended review times to 12 days and mandated 5-minute pre-submission testing
[Root Cause & Mechanism] High volume of submissions and excessive re-reviews caused by basic build errors
[Key Fact Detail] Valve facing severe review backlog.
[Key Position & Outlook] Aiming to reduce re-reviews caused by basic bugs.

title: Traversal Hits $1 Billion Valuation As Software Becomes Harder To Troubleshoot
title_en: Traversal Hits $1 Billion Valuation As Software Becomes Harder To Troubleshoot
author: Rashi Shrivastava
content_snippet: Traversal has raised $120 million in funding to help companies like American Express and Pepsi troubleshoot site outages. — for The Prompt
summary_en: SRE automation startup Traversal has secured $120 million in funding led by Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint, and Khosla Ventures, reaching a $1 billion valuation. The company deploys AI agents to automate site reliability engineering, aiming to replace human intervention in complex system maintenance.
title_zh: SRE智能体独角兽Traversal完成1.2亿美元融资，估值突破10亿美元大关
summary_zh: 运维AI初创公司Traversal完成1.2亿美元融资，估值达10亿美元，将AI Agent引入站点可靠性工程领域

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 运维自动化初创公司Traversal近日获得由Kleiner Perkins、Redpoint和Khosla Ventures领投的1.2亿美元注资，估值正式突破10亿美元大关。公司核心业务是通过AI智能体处理站点可靠性工程（SRE），旨在替代人力解决复杂的系统故障与维护问题。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: SRE automation startup Traversal has secured $120 million in funding led by Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint, and Khosla Ventures, reaching a $1 billion valuation. The company deploys AI agents to automate site reliability engineering, aiming to replace human intervention in complex system maintenance.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】运维AI初创公司Traversal在企业融资市场：完成1.2亿美元融资，晋升为估值10亿美元的独角兽企业
【起因与机理】利用AI Agent自动化解决SRE运维难题，资本押注运维领域的降本增效
【关键数据与实测】运维AI初创公司Traversal完成1.2亿融资。
【各方立场与态度】通过AI智能体实现系统故障自动修复。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] SRE AI startup Traversal (Corporate venture capital market): Raised $120M, reaching a $1B valuation
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Capitalizing on the demand for AI agents to automate SRE and reduce operational costs
[Key Metrics] Traversal raises $120M in funding.
[Key Position & Outlook] Automating system fault resolution via AI agents.
image_caption: Traversal AI site reliability engineering agent platform. (Forbes)
paragraphs_zh: 专注于站点可靠性工程（SRE）与云基础设施自主运维的 AI 智能体初创企业 Traversal 宣布完成1.2亿美元新一轮融资，由凯鹏华盈（Kleiner Perkins）、红点创投（Redpoint）与科斯拉创投（Khosla Ventures）联合领投，估值突破10亿美元跻身独角兽行列。
随着生成式编程工具的普及，企业代码交付量呈指数级爆发，分布式系统的复杂度已远超传统人工值班工程师的排障极限。Traversal 的智能体系统通过全链路遥测监控、因果异常归因以及自主生成修复代码分支，将故障平均恢复时间（MTTR）缩短数倍。
新注资金将全面用于自愈型分布式系统底层算法的研发，并拓展针对全球云原生巨头的高级企业级部署。
lead_paragraph: Traversal, which builds autonomous AI agents for site reliability engineering (SRE) and cloud infrastructure debugging, raised $120 million in a funding round co-led by Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint Ventures, and Khosla Ventures, valuing the company at $1 billion.
lead_paragraph_zh: 专注于站点可靠性工程（SRE）与云基础设施自主运维的 AI 智能体初创企业 Traversal 宣布完成1.2亿美元新一轮融资，由凯鹏华盈（Kleiner Perkins）、红点创投（Redpoint）与科斯拉创投（Khosla Ventures）联合领投，估值突破10亿美元跻身独角兽行列。

summary_en: At the AI Engineer conference in New York, Revolut ops and infrastructure lead David Abitbol revealed that the fintech firm slashed its AI coding inference costs by roughly 90% in less than a year. title: Super Micro reports Q1 revenue up 298% YoY to $19.95B, vs. $16.39B est., and forecasts Q2 revenue above estimates; SMCI jumps 7%+ after hours (Reuters)

author: Reuters
content_snippet: Super Micro Computer (SMCI.O) forecast second-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates on Tuesday as strong demand for its AI-optimized servers boosted sales …

title: AMD reports Q3 revenue up 45% YoY to $13.38B, vs. $13.09B est., Data Center revenue up 97% to $8.5B, forecasts Q4 revenue above est.; AMD jumps 7%+ after hours (Katie Tarasov/CNBC)
title_en: AMD reports Q3 revenue up 45% YoY to $13.38B, vs. $13.09B est., Data Center revenue up 97% to $8.5B, forecasts Q4 revenue above est.; AMD jumps 7%+ after hours (Katie Tarasov/CNBC)
author: CNBC
content_snippet:
Advanced Micro Devices reported third-quarter earnings on Tuesday that beat Wall Street's expectations, with revenue jump 45% and data center sales nearly doubling from a year earlier. The stock jumped 7% in extended trading.

Revenue increased from $9.25 billion a year earlier, AMD said in a statement.

CEO Lisa Su said in a press release that she expects growth in data center processors to "accelerate further," and that meeting demand won't be a problem.

"With our leadership product portfolio
summary_en: AMD announced third-quarter revenue of $13.38 billion, up 45% year-over-year and beating expectations, driven by a 97% surge in data center sales to $8.5 billion. CEO Lisa Su expressed strong confidence in meeting accelerating demand, sending the stock up over 7% in extended trading.
title_zh: AMD 报告称，第三季度收入同比增长 45% 至 $13.38B，预期为 $13.09B；数据中心收入增长 97% 至 $8.5B，预计第四季度收入高于预期； AMD 盘后股价上涨 7% 以上
summary_zh: Advanced Micro Devices 周二公布的第三季度财报超出了华尔街的预期，收入增长 45%，数据中心销售额同比增长近一倍。该股在盘后交易中上涨了 7%。 AMD 在一份声明中表示，营收较上年同期的 92.5 亿美元有所增长

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: AMD在财报会议上宣布，其第三季度总营收达到133.8亿美元，同比大幅增长45%并超越华尔街预期的130.9亿美元。在首席执行官苏姿丰的带领下，核心的数据中心业务销售额同比飙升97%至85亿美元、占总营收64%，同时公司信心满满地预计第四季度营收将继续超预期，刺激其盘后股价直线拉升超7%。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: AMD announced third-quarter revenue of $13.38 billion, up 45% year-over-year and beating expectations, driven by a 97% surge in data center sales to $8.5 billion. CEO Lisa Su expressed strong confidence in meeting accelerating demand, sending the stock up over 7% in extended trading.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】AMD与CEO苏姿丰（Lisa Su）：公布Q3营收133.8亿美元（同比增45%超预期），数据中心业务大增97%至85亿美元，并给出强劲的Q4营收展望，盘后股价涨超7%

【关键数据与实测】数据中心业务飙升97%撑起大半江山。
【各方立场与态度】苏姿丰对未来供应链与交付能力充满信心。

Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is just 15.7 months. Claims about what models can't do expire fastest.

content_snippet:
Around 50 percent of recently surveyed US adults have at one time used an AI chatbot, and 8 percent say they have used these tools ahead of the midterms to find information on candidates and policies, according to Pew Research.

title: The Download: controlling AI agents and “Super Intelligence” loyalty tests
title_en: The Download: controlling AI agents and “Super Intelligence” loyalty tests
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to stick to the rules.

While game theory predicts how rational actors behave under particular rules, reverse game theory designs rules to elicit the behavior we want. Think of splitting a cake: if one person cuts it and the other gets first choice, the cutter has an incentive to make the portions equal.

Researchers believe the approach could align AI more closely with our
summary_en: Researchers are attempting to tame future AI using 'reverse game theory,' designing rules where AI is incentivized to follow instructions rather than rebel. This approach aims to address superintelligence risks by structurally aligning AI behaviors with human interests through strategic incentive design.

title: Anthropic's Message Threads cut time to first token by 35 percent for long conversations
title_en: Anthropic's Message Threads cut time to first token by 35 percent for long conversations
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
Anthropic released Message Threads for the Messages API. Instead of resending the entire conversation with every turn, agents now only transmit what's changed. For requests between 500,000 and one million tokens, time to first token drops by about 35 percent.

The article Anthropic's Message Threads cut time to first token by 35 percent for long conversations appeared first on The Decoder.
summary_en: Anthropic introduced 'Message Threads' for its Messages API, shifting away from resending full conversation history in each request. By transmitting only the changes, the update reduces the time-to-first-token by 35% for long-context interactions.

title: Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
title_en: Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
Huawei is telling customers to source the high-performance memory for its AI chips on their own, pushing them onto the black market. Smugglers are exploiting a loophole in U.S. export rules by bundling HBM with low-end processors, shipping them through Hong Kong, and separating the chips on site. Prices for smuggled HBM3E memory have surged to around $4,000 per unit in just one year.

The article Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the
summary_en: Huawei is telling customers to independently source high-performance memory for its AI chips, effectively shifting procurement to the black market. Due to U.S. export controls, smugglers are exploiting loopholes by bundling HBM with low-end processors via Hong Kong and splitting them on-site, causing HBM3E prices to skyrocket to $4,000 per unit.
